transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Lately, I’ve been eating very little and skipping most of my meals. Because of that, I've lost a lot of weight recently.
Are you avoiding food mainly because you’re afraid of gaining weight or feel like your body is too large, even though others may say you are thin?

Yes, I am absolutely terrified of gaining any weight, so I restrict my food as much as possible. When I look in the mirror, I still feel so big and fat, even though everyone else tells me I'm too thin.
Have you had any physical changes from the weight loss, like your periods stopping, feeling faint, or getting very weak?
I'm not really sure about those physical changes, and I haven't noticed anything like my periods stopping or feeling faint. I've mostly just been focused on keeping my weight down.
Have you also had episodes of binge eating or tried to get rid of calories by vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things like binge eating, vomiting, or taking laxatives. My focus is really just on eating as little as possible and strictly restricting my food intake.
How long have you been restricting your food and losing weight like this?
I'm not entirely sure how long it's been, as I haven't really kept track of the exact timeline. I've just been so focused on restricting my meals day by day that I lost track of when it all started.
